title: Menstrual Health and Hygiene
summary: The session was conducted by Dr. Nilima Inamdar, covering important aspects of menstrual cycle and hygiene, primary and secondary sexual characteristics, personal responsibility and healthy lifestyle choices.
description:
The session was conducted by Dr. Nilima Inamdar, covering important aspects of menstrual cycle and hygiene, primary and secondary sexual characteristics, personal responsibility and healthy lifestyle choices. The discussion focused not just on health, but also on helping young people develop awareness, empathy, respect and responsible habits.
Thank you Dr. Nilima Inamdar for such an amazing and insightful session.
